platforms.short_bio: Asc3nd exists to equip young people with the confidence, support, and opportunities they need to keep moving forward.
platforms.long_about: The Asc3nd Collective was founded by Otha and Elisha Minnifield on a simple belief: one caring mentor, one meaningful opportunity, and one supportive community can change the trajectory of a young person's life. Through Mentorship, Leadership, Life Skills & Athletics, and Community Connection, we empower youth in Seattle/King County to discover their potential and build a brighter future.

platforms.about: The Asc3nd Collective is a Seattle/King County nonprofit founded by Otha and Elisha Minnifield. We invest in young people through four pillars: Mentorship, Leadership, Life Skills & Athletics, and Community Connection. Our mission is to ensure every young person has the confidence, support, and opportunities they need to keep moving forward.
